messages:
Tariq A: NewtonHealth RFI landed. High level asks: capability matrix, PoC runbook, redacted FIPS attestation, quantization guidance for cost targets, and an apples-to-apples pricing for 750k calls/day over 90 days. Who takes what?
Emma L: I can own the capability matrix + attach links to docs. Connor, can you do PoC runbook and ops window?
Connor P: Yep Ill take runbook and provisioning. Prefer weekend setup. infra-bot: available windows for dedicated pools -> 2026-06-06 and 2026-06-13.
infra-bot: Tentative hold placed for 2026-06-13 07:00-11:00 UTC pending PO.
Tariq A: Newton requires EU residency and FIPS 140-2 HSM evidence. Legal will want redaction rules. legal-bot: redaction policy -> remove serials, certificate fingerprints; share redacted PDF in package, full on SFTP with NDA.
legal-bot: Recommend adding: "Full attestation available on request via secure channel after NDA" in answers.
Emma L: Proposed capability matrix columns: Feature | Supported | Deployment modes | EU residency | KMS/HSM | Quantization supported | SLA (p95) | Typical p95 (512 tok) | Scale (QPS) | Attachments/notes.
Emma L: Seed rows (inline):
```
Text generation, Y, Hosted/Dedicated/Private, EU, Customer KMS (keywrap)/HSM, INT8/FP16 supported on dedicated/private, 99.95, 140ms, 400 QPS per 8-GPU pool, see note on quality vs quant
Embeddings, Y, Hosted/Dedicated, EU, Customer KMS, Quantization not recommended, 99.99, 70ms, 150 QPS, private onprem roadmap Q4
```
Connor P: PoC runbook draft: 0) NDA & attestation gating, 1) Provision weekend (sat), 2) Baseline perf + correctness, 3) Replay customer traffic, 4) Security verification + red-team smoke, 5) Handover and metrics review. Suggest provisioning 2026-06-13.
Tariq A: Pricing ask: apples-to-apples for 750k calls/day assumed avg tokens=700, mix text/emb 92/8. pricing-bot: draft scenarios uploaded -> newton_pricing_draft_v1.csv -> https://drive.redwood/newton_pricing_draft_v1.csv
pricing-bot: Quick draft estimate: Hosted PAYG ~$2,025,000 over 90 days (token heavy). Reserved: 10xA100-equivalent pool $48,000/mo + overage -> ~$1,080,000 (estimate) assuming 60% utilization. Attach CSV for details.
Emma L: Note: quantization can cut token cost ~25-40% but may increase p95 by ~10-25ms depending on model. Marked as a note in matrix: "Quantization tradeoffs: cost vs latency/quality".
Connor P: Ops note: Newton wants a hard SLA clause and breach remedies in the SOW. Legal, can we accept their proposed wording on uptime credits?
legal-bot: We'll review. Major enterprise blocker flagged: Newton asked for indemnity language beyond standard; legal to escalate to commercial.
Tariq A: On attestation, we'll include redacted_fips_attestation_v1.pdf in package. Connor please attach anonymized network diagram (no IPs).
Connor P: Uploaded: newton_poc_runbook_v1.md -> https://drive.redwood/newton_poc_runbook_v1.md and newton_kms_flow_redacted.png -> https://drive.redwood/newton_kms_flow_redacted.png
Emma L: Uploaded: newton_capability_matrix_v1.csv -> https://drive.redwood/newton_capability_matrix_v1.csv. I added the quantization column and linked the pricing draft.
pricing-bot: Uploaded refined pricing: newton_pricing_draft_v2.csv -> https://drive.redwood/newton_pricing_draft_v2.csv. Included sensitivity at 50/70/90% utilization.
Tariq A: Target send date for full RFI bundle: 2026-06-01 COB. Action items: Emma finish matrix notes + mark "attestation on request"; Connor finalize runbook + attach diagram; Legal follow up on indemnity wording; Pricing finalize numbers and include reserved vs hosted breakdown.
Emma L: Will update matrix and add the attestation text today.
Connor P: I'll finalize runbook and confirm infra hold once PO is closer.
legal-bot: Escalating indemnity ask. Will update by 2026-05-28.
Tariq A: Thanks team. If anything blocks, flag here. Will draft cover email once attachments are final. :email:
